features.bestImplementationHint: Uses WebSocket and serverless functions for real-time updates.

features.description: Syncs changes across all views of a diagram in real-time.
features.bestImplementationHint: Real-time database triggers and event listeners for instant synchronization.

features.bestImplementationHint: Uses regular expressions and custom workflows to ensure compliance.

features.bestImplementationHint: Analyzes user feedback and industry norms to offer suggestions.

features.name: Third-party application integration

universe.sourceDescription: Derived from 8 competitor analysis (14 unique features)

scores.evidence: DanteClicky has real-time collaboration features with multiple users editing diagrams simultaneously.
Changes across all views of a diagram are synced in near real-time.
Customizable validation rules are implemented but require manual setup and configuration.
Automated feedback for design decisions is not fully implemented; it provides basic insights but lacks detailed analysis based on best practices.
Third-party application integration is supported, connecting with external tools.
Visual collaboration tools are available for real-time communication and document sharing during meetings.
Risk assessment dashboard is implemented but lacks comprehensive risk visualization and mitigation strategies.
Task prioritization based on dependencies is partially implemented, with basic functionality but limited to certain scenarios.
Code review automation feature is not present at all; no evidence of machine learning in the code review process.
Workflow automation is supported, reducing manual steps in workflows by automating repetitive tasks.
DanteClicky provides limited pre-built templates and symbols for common use cases.
Automated UI testing is available but has minor gaps in coverage and error handling.
Self-healing components are not present at all.
Cloud provider integration exists, but it's basic and lacks support for multiple services.
